data.title: FracPro Live+- Minifrac- Display and Update Magenta Circle on LogLog Plot
data.description: As a Live+ user, I want a magenta circle to be displayed on the LogLog plot at the Closure point so that I can visually identify the measured bottom-hole pressure corresponding to the selected Closure time

acceptance_criteria.text: Scenario 1: Display Magenta Circle Given the LogLog plot is displayed When the plot is rendered Then Display a single magenta circle at the intersection of the Closure (magenta vertical line) and the Meas'd Btmh Press curve. Scenario 2: Update Magenta Circle Given the magenta circle is displayed When the Closure line is moved Then Update the magenta circle position to the new intersection with the Meas'd Btmh Press curve. The existing circle shall move instead of creating a new one. The update shall occur immediately without requiring the plot to be refreshed.
